limitations.title: Operations Ask AI is inconsistent
limitations.evidence: Admin order query, Manager order query and Manager knowledge query returned HTTP 503. Technician order/knowledge and Admin knowledge succeeded. Safe server reasons INVALID_EXCERPT and PROVIDER_FAILURE were observed; exact per-request reason is not available for every failure.
limitations.next: Targeted provider/runtime investigation with fixed fixtures; preserve scoped evidence and exact-excerpt checks.

limitations.title: Native model sometimes ignores required source reading or returns incomplete output
limitations.evidence: First Admin focus returned Sources only; first preparation was rejected with TOOL_CHOICE_IGNORED. One explicit selected-order retry prepared and executed a saved proposal.
limitations.next: Improve current provider/tool compatibility and failure recovery without accepting unsupported model content.

limitations.title: AI proposal date did not match the requested date
limitations.evidence: Requested 8 October 2026 10:00 MYT; the saved proposal used 10 August. Main verified order/technician but missed date before confirmation. Manager later corrected the same order to 2026-10-08T02:00:00Z while preserving technician.
limitations.next: Verify every canonical field against the actual request before approval; add a targeted date/locale regression before claiming reliable AI scheduling.

limitations.title: Native knowledge requests completed as clarification without cited guidance
limitations.evidence: Both recorded native guidance requests returned clarification views; these prove completed safe responses, not successful knowledge retrieval.
limitations.next: Investigate literal query selection with an actual citation assertion.

limitations.title: Formal order detail still shows technician UUID
limitations.evidence: The formal Manager order detail renders a stored technician identifier; the recording captions do not replace this UI.
limitations.next: Separate UI change decision; no product UI modified in this recording task.
